page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head "INDEX." at top centre; then continuation lines of an index entry in italic, a heading "PARS SECVNDA.", then a list of chapter entries with page references at right. Catchword "Cap." at lower right.

main_text.p: divinæ veritatis censeatur. satis esse, ut propo-sitionum, ex quibus ea eruitur, altera extet in Scripturis. p.82

page.notes: Page numbers in the printed index are given as "p.82", "p.98" etc.; the first entry's "p.82" and the last entry's "p.127" are as printed. Long s rendered as s. The "CAP." at the foot is a catchword. The entry for Cap. IV has its page number wrapped onto a new line as printed.
